summary: Iteration 2: full backend + frontend regression after the OmniLocal #1 rebrand, OAuth connector routes, and distribution pathways refactor. 26/26 pytest backend tests pass; all critical frontend flows work end-to-end (Command Center brand, sidebar nav, no legacy names, Executioner run/reset, OAuth Connect/Disconnect flip for tiktok, Content Director distribution card + Generate 3 Posts + video critic, Maximizer 4 games + spin + CSV import segmenting + Send Welcome email toast with Reply-To/List-Unsubscribe headers).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py oauth_start / oauth_callback return HTTP 200 with an `error` field for unknown platforms instead of a proper 4xx (e.g. 404). Consider raising HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='unknown platform') so clients can branch cleanly.
server.py `spin()` uses `random.Random()` (unseeded) — non-deterministic. Fine for the demo feel, but flagged in iteration 1 and still present.
server.py L1137 has minor test assertion redundancy in the welcome flow (already covered elsewhere). Not a product bug.
server.py WELCOME_QUEUE grows unbounded across imports (each CSV import appends). Consider clearing or deduping by email on each import so repeated demos don't produce a long queue.
Frontend `App.js` mobile nav uses `mnav-*` testids while sidebar uses `nav-*`. Both work; document in the testing context.

server.py oauth_callback returns `authorized` at the top level (not per-platform on subsequent GETs). The GET /connections response has `authorized` on each platform entry, which is the right shape — good.
No pagination or size limit on WELCOME_QUEUE or REPORTS in-memory stores — acceptable for demo, worth noting for productionization.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend seeds itself deterministically (3 weeks of reports via INITIAL_WEEKS, 15 RFMD customers, drip). Tests call POST /api/executioner/reset before/after mutating reports to keep state predictable, and disconnect tiktok after OAuth tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 26 tests, all pass, ~2s runtime with -n auto). Base URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Nav testids: nav-overview|executioner|maximizer|content (sidebar) and mnav-* (mobile). Social connector testids: connect-<platform> / disconnect-<platform> for facebook|instagram|google|tiktok|youtube. The Connections UI is embedded at the bottom of the Executioner page (must scroll). Distribution pathways card is on Content Director with data-testid distribution-pathways and pathway-<platform> items. Welcome flow: load-customers-btn → import-customers-btn on Maximizer, then send-welcome-<index>. Welcome email is stubbed (RESEND_API_KEY empty) and returns status='stubbed' with Reply-To + List-Unsubscribe + List-Unsubscribe-Post headers.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. The OAuth connector refactor, distribution pathways, and rebrand cleanup all landed cleanly with no 404s and no console errors.
